svg.title: Pinging the ping node
svg.desc: Matched for commanding, Send ping in the ping window sends ping 1 with the MOC's time up through the gateway node to the ping node, which adds its own time and sends it back down to the ground's port for it; the window shows the round trip and each way. Not matched, nothing goes up and a pop-up says why.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold

svg.text: [A] made with configuration A: solid line
Arrowhead: read or acted on. Cross: dropped and counted, or not acted on. The words at each end say which.
